title: 第13章 炎门的追杀第14章 幽冥火
content_zh:
自从那个臭庶民死了，这人生又变得无趣，本来就想玩玩他，可他却不禁玩，一不小心就玩死了，哼，白白的浪费了我一个炎门标记定位，本来还想着，时时刻刻知道他的位置，在去那里围追堵截玩耍他，现在不能玩咯。
焱言家宽大的房子，笔墨纸砚，香炉屏风，样样俱全。
焱言的父亲是长老，所以他家自然大富大贵，以前因为性格顽劣，玩性不恭，打伤同门弟子，而又拒不承认错误，所以被留了一级，如果他的父亲不是长老的话，他可能就要被逐出炎门，可谁让他就是呢，他有飘的这个资格。
焱言的乐趣不在于修炼，而在于玩弄他人，看到他人的失败，看到他人的耻辱，他就会觉得很开心。
他望着眼前的定位镜，一个蓝点的位置，竟然开始移动了！
难道那个庶民还没死？怎么可能？
焱言邪魅一笑，竟然没死，那不是更好了嘛？哈哈哈，本来上次，就是为了冲击二级异能才跟着掌门去福天宝地，被你给搅黄了，不过，现在我也终于是突破二级异能。
“来人，顺着这个定位，给我找到这个庶民，把他带回来，拒不从命的话，直接杀掉！”
“是”
三个侍卫们退下，得到命令，直接按着定位来找应无悔。
幽火草，狱火行者说就在这些甬道当中，可这些甬道四通八达，绵延不绝，跟迷宫一样，我都怕我找到了幽火草，但是我走不出去了。
甬道内漆黑无光，应无悔打着火把，洞内阴暗潮湿，时不时有一些动物走动的声音，只要不遇到异能兽就好。
侍卫们顺着定位，马上发现此人在山崖底下，这里万丈深渊，我们只能走另一条路，那条是接近人界兽界的边缘线，要小心绕路，遇到兽族可就麻烦了。
传说兽族与人族的始祖，因为争夺此间宝地，展开了长达几百天的大战，一时惊起惊涛骇浪，开山裂地，大战的破坏性，硬生生的开出一道万丈深渊，也就是这里，宝地受到冲击而崩坏，两人也各自受到重创，不久之后便陨落，此后兽族与人族的边界，就是这里。
应无悔不断走着，时要俯下身子，时要侧着身，时而趴在地上爬行。
好难找，应无悔已走了两三个公里，毫无发现。
甬道中的蝙蝠是最多的，其次是蜥蜴，还有一些毒虫蜈蚣，应无悔，能避就避，实在躲不掉的，只能放火烧了它们。
忙活了一天，就找到一棵很小的幽火草，还好应无悔标记过，每走过一个地方，就画上一个标记，他顺着标记回去，到了夜晚，明月已经挂上树梢，星星点点，微风吹来，却也不解疲惫的身体。
应无悔拿着这一棵幽火草，走了回去，回到洞穴，他叫狱火行者出来，问他是不是这棵。
“就是这个，可是你这个品级太差，还没完全长大，你摘了一个幼年的”

狱火行者说。
“幼年，难怪这么小”
应无悔叹气道，“蚂蚁虽小，也可以吃，虽然这棵幽火草，品阶是差了点，但你吸收了它，也可以提升点异能修为”
“没办法了，只能明天再继续找”
安安早早的就睡着了，毕竟应无悔回来也不早了。
侍卫们日夜兼程，终于，他们骑着马赶到这里。
“就在附近，都找找！”
侍卫头领说道。
应无悔迟迟睡不着，他总感觉今天会发生什么？心里很烦闷。
到影子从前面出来，射进了洞穴中。
应无悔双眼睁大，有人！
他立马起身，只见那个身影，越来越延伸进来，应无悔在洞的周围，瞄了一眼，炎门的，他们衣服上都有一个棱镜一样的徽标，外围是熊熊燃烧的火焰，这个标记，应无悔再熟悉不过。

Ever since that stinky commoner died, life has become boring again. I originally wanted to play with him, but he couldn't help but play with him. He accidentally died playing with him. Humph, I wasted my location of the Flame Gate mark. I originally wanted to know his location at all times and chase him there, but I can't play with him now.
The spacious house of Yan Yan's family is equipped with everything including pens, inks, paper and inkstones, incense burners and screens.
Yan Yan's father is an elder, so his family is naturally rich and powerful. In the past, because of his naughty character and disrespectful play, he injured his fellow disciples and refused to admit his mistakes, he was left one level behind. If his father were not an elder, he might have been expelled from the Yan Clan, but who let him be? He has the qualification to be floating.
Yan Yan's pleasure lies not in cultivation, but in toying with others. He will feel very happy when he sees the failure of others and the shame of others.
He looked at the positioning mirror in front of him, and a blue dot started to move!
Is that commoner not dead yet? How is it possible?
Yan Yan smiled evilly, and he didn't die. Wouldn't that be better? Hahaha, originally, last time, I followed the leader to Futian Treasure Land just to break through the second-level superpower, but you messed me up. However, now I have finally broken through the second-level superpower.
"Come here, follow this position, find this commoner for me, and bring him back. If he refuses to obey, kill him directly!"
"Yes"
The three guards retreated, received the order, and went directly to find Ying Wuhui according to their location.
The Hellfire Walker said that the Dark Fire Grass is among these corridors, but these corridors extend in all directions and stretch endlessly, just like a maze. I was afraid that I would find the Dark Fire Grass, but I would not be able to get out.
The corridor was dark and lightless, and Ying Wuhui was holding a torch. The cave was dark and damp, and there were sounds of animals moving around from time to time. As long as he didn't encounter any supernatural beasts, that would be fine.
The guards followed the position and immediately discovered that this person was at the bottom of the cliff. There was an abyss here. We could only take another road, which was close to the edge of the human world and the beast world. We had to be careful to take detours, otherwise we would be in trouble if we encountered the beast tribe.
Legend has it that the ancestors of the beast race and the human race fought for hundreds of days for the treasure land here. The battle suddenly aroused huge waves, cracked the mountains and the ground, and the destructiveness of the war opened up an abyss. It was here that the treasure land was impacted and collapsed. Both of them were seriously injured and fell soon after. From then on, the boundary between the beast race and the human race was here.
Ying Wu regrets and keeps walking, sometimes leaning down, sometimes sideways, and sometimes crawling on the ground.
It was so hard to find. Ying Wuhui had walked two or three kilometers without finding anything.
There are the most bats in the corridor, followed by lizards, and some poisonous insects and centipedes. You should have no regrets and avoid them if you can. If you really can't avoid them, you can only set them on fire.
After a busy day, he found a very small fire grass. Fortunately, Ying Wuhui had marked it. Every time he passed a place, he drew a mark. He followed the mark back. At night, the bright moon had already hung on the treetops, and the stars were dotted. The breeze blew, but it did not relieve his tired body.
Ying Wuhui took this Netherfire Grass and walked back to the cave. He called Hellfire Walker out and asked him if it was this one.
"That's it, but your grade is too low. It's not fully grown yet. You picked a young one."
Hellfire Walker said.
"Young age, no wonder you are so young"
Ying Wuhui sighed and said, "Although ants are small, they can still be eaten. Although the grade of this Nether Fire Grass is a bit low, but if you absorb it, you can also improve your abilities."
"I have no choice but to continue looking tomorrow."
An An fell asleep early. After all, it was not too early for Ying Wuhui to come back.
The guards traveled day and night, and finally they arrived here on horseback.
"It's nearby, look for it!"
The leader of the guards said.
Ying Wurui couldn't sleep for a long time. He always felt like what would happen today? I felt very upset.
to the shadow coming out from the frontCome and shoot into the cave.
Ying Wuhui opened his eyes wide, there was someone!
He immediately stood up and saw the figure extending more and more in. Ying Wuhui glanced around the hole. They all had a prism-like logo on their clothes from the Yanmen, with a blazing flame on the outside. This mark was something that Ying Wuhui was all too familiar with.
